thread:
alex: Heads-up — kernel + quant merge tonight at 23:00 UTC. Build id qkernel-20260321-rc3 (sha256: ab12c3d4ef567890abcdef1234567890fedcba98). Planning a small canary then ramp. :rocket:

maria: Thanks. Can we lock down rollback criteria and pin TTL before we start? Also need a release-notes bullet.

samir: Rollback criteria proposal: any sustained 5m error rate >0.5% OR p99 latency regression >50ms vs baseline OR any OOM/driver faults. If triggered, immediate pin to engine:qkernel:stable and cut canary.

jen: Pin TTL suggestion: 12h sticky pin with manual clear. If we see flapping, extend to 48h. Also add a manual emergency pin command to the runbook: `deploybot pin engine:qkernel:stable --reason "rollback" --ttl 12h`

deploy-bot: Preflight started for qkernel-20260321-rc3
- smoke tests: running
- kernel ABI check: OK
- quant integrity: sha256 check pass

ops-bot: Telemetry probe created: /ops/telemetry/qkernel-rc3-canary (retention 7d). Baseline snapshots taken.

alex: Canary plan: 1% slice for 15m, then 5% for 30m, then 20% for 60m if no signals. Ramp steps are automated but require explicit ack to cross 5% -> 20% (safety latch).

maria: Add release note draft line: "quant kernel: reordering matmul kernel & fused KV cache op — expected throughput +5% for batchy chat workloads; verify for short seqs (<=64)". I'll drop a link to the draft after this thread.

samir: Quick check: can we run the microbench `tools/bench/matmul --sizes 64 128` against rc3 in staging? If regressions >3% on p95 we abort.

jen: Ops checklist reminder: ensure builds are pinned in artifact-registry and the `runtime-bundle` manifest points to qkernel-20260321-rc3. If we need a hot rollback we should have artifact `qkernel-20260211-stable` ready to pin.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed (unit + e2e). Canary deploy command queued:
```
deploy apply --bundle qkernel-20260321-rc3 --slice 1% --reason "nightly canary"
```

ops-bot: Staging microbench results: matmul p95 = baseline * 0.98 (2% faster), no OOMs observed on 8xA100 short runs. Thermal sensors nominal.

alex: OK launching at 23:00 UTC. Samir you own immediate roll decision if we hit the criteria. Maria you'll own the release note entry and product comms. Jen you'll watch artifact pins and ops commands.

maria: Will add RN and ping #product at T+30.

samir: I'll be by my laptop. If deploy-bot posts any error I'm calling rollback.

jen: If we need to pin from deploybot console the command is: `deploybot pin engine:qkernel:v20260211 --ttl 12h --reason "rollback qkernel rc3"` — ops oncall knows the shortcut.

alex: One more: canary telemetry windows to watch: 5xx count, p95 latency, kv cache hit ratio, GPU mem pressure. Ops-bot please surface alerts to #eng-oncall and DM paging if OOM.

ops-bot: Alert routes configured. Paging -> #eng-oncall (sev2) and mobile for oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary started (1%) — slice id s-20260321-01. I'll post updates at ramps.

jen: :thumbsup: Good luck everyone. Ping if we need to freeze the window.

alex: Thanks — night window owner is me. Will post final status after 90m. :thumbsup:
